pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/AssetScoutView/AssetRow.tsx:29 Clicking Acquire records only the asset's id and name, even though `asset.source` is available in the same component, so no source and no licence are ever written; the acquired list then shows a green 'Integration ready' badge and no licence line, so an unknown licence reads as no restriction.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/AssetScoutView/AssetRow.tsx:29 The acquisition record is written without source, price or licence. `AcquiredAsset.licence` exists in src/types/marketplace.ts, but no code fills it in. AcquiredAssetsList.tsx:42 still shows a success-variant 'Integration ready' badge, where the technique wants a deferral that names the missing licence.

pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-forge/iconSetRun.ts:12 The icon-set runner posts every planned paid contact sheet in turn with no local reservation and no stop latch, so a quota or rate-limit failure on one sheet does not stop the next paid dispatch.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-forge/iconSetRun.ts:12 The loop at line 98 marks any non-400 error as 'failed' and keeps going. Nothing latches on quota or 429 evidence, and there is no per-window or per-slot cap. This is the failure mode the technique names: 'the loop that finds the ceiling by hitting it'.

src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-forge/forgeJobStatus.ts:160 A completed job with no `accepted` and no `ungated` field is shown as the green 'complete' state, so the absence of a verdict counts as a pass ('green by default'). The file's own comment at line 101 says a path that projects none of these fields 'silently read[s] as passes'. The client side, though, removed its placeholder branch (GenerationPanel.tsx:132).

src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-forge/useForgeStore.ts:78 Every image-to-3D submit passes the Tier-0 input gate before the provider call. A failing image is refused before any spend, and a gate that could not run is surfaced through `inputGateNote` instead of being treated as a pass.

src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-forge/forgeJobStatus.ts:2 This meets the single-source rule: the route's projection and the client's consumption read one shared shape, so they cannot drift. The shape carries attempts, accepted, ungated and gateReason.

src/lib/visual-gen/style-dna-job-store.ts:76 A failed Style DNA distillation ends as an error with its reason. No empty stand-in profile is saved and later injected into generation prompts.

pairs.evidence: scripts/visual-gen/pof_tripo_smartlowpoly_arena.ts:256 The arena sends one paid Tripo task after another with no local ledger and no stop latch; a failed task, including a quota or 429 failure, is recorded as ok:false and the loop dispatches the next paid task, with only a human abort to stop it.

techniques.evidence: scripts/visual-gen/pof_tripo_smartlowpoly_arena.ts:256 There is no reservation under a lock, no cap and no durable latch. Related: pof_leonardo.mjs:83 deletes the cloud generation in `finally` even when the poll timed out (line 72), which destroys the provider-side evidence of a call whose outcome is unknown. pof_tripo.mjs:14 `--resume ... never re-buy it` does follow the 'charge the uncertain, do not re-dispatch' rule.

pairs.subject: generative-artifact-gating
pairs.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/reference-conformance.ts:127 The vision grader's SEVERITY value is clamped into 0..3 instead of being failed closed, so an out-of-schema reply such as SEVERITY=-1 becomes 0 and grades as `match`.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/reference-conformance.ts:127 The rule is that a schema violation fails closed and an out-of-range value is ungraded; clamping guesses on the model's behalf. One mitigation: the verdict is advisory only and is not folded into pass/fail (line 29).

src/lib/visual-gen/linear-prop-routing.ts:5 Linear props (rope and similar) have a declared constructed producer. Prompts for that class are refused before the generator and sent to the procedural `linear-prop` route.
src/lib/visual-gen/linear-prop-routing.ts:58 The shape-route gate runs on the input before the paid generate call; the refusal text states that no generation was spent.

pairs.registryProposal: In generator-failure-deterministic-gates, 'a schema violation fails closed' could name clamping into the valid range explicitly as a failure. It is the most common way parsers quietly turn an out-of-range value into an in-range verdict.
